title: The Future of Research Infrastructure
targetDuration: 1–2 minutes; hard maximum 120 seconds after measured voice timing

scenes.title: More results, less certainty
scenes.viewerPurpose: More output can leave a team unclear about knowledge. Proposes a persistent research control plane that retains questions, evidence, decisions, agents and human authority through changing tools and people.
scenes.composition: A scientist faces new analyses and two notebooks while the original question stays unresolved. Use one strong scene title, flat uncluttered backgrounds, and enough quiet space for the current caption.

cues.text: By lunchtime, an AI-assisted laboratory has new analyses and reports, but no clear view of what they establish.
cues.visualAction: A scientist faces new analyses and two notebooks while the original question stays unresolved.
cues.emotion: Measured surprise; gently emphasize “what they establish”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.

cues.text: The Future of Research Infrastructure proposes a lasting shared workspace where questions, evidence, decisions, and responsibility stay connected.
cues.visualAction: Gather the evidence and decision records around the same persistent question.
cues.emotion: Clear and warmly interested; give a small emphasis to “stay connected”, then finish at an ordinary conversational pace without a dramatic rise.
